selection_rule: SHA256 over UTF-8 pipe-separated fields, starting with seed 46. Select empty then nonempty independently by round-robin of sources, unused sources first then hash of seed|source|class|source_id. Within each source maximize minimum distance to already selected physical centers from that source; break ties by hash of seed|center|class|source_id|physical_frame. Classes are named empty/nonempty.
schedule_rule: Order all 12 IDs by SHA256 of seed|epoch|zero_based_epoch|sample_id per epoch. Concatenate epochs then truncate after 400 B=1 updates.
